strategies.name: ema_support_scalp_long
strategies.entry_summary: After the first 5 to 15 minutes, look for price to bounce off support on the 5-minute chart, especially when the 13 EMA is acting as initial support. Enter on the bounce/reclaim of that support level for a quick scalp long.
strategies.exit_summary: Exit quickly into nearby resistance or after the short impulse move; the speaker emphasizes getting in and out, not overstaying, and taking profit once the scalp move completes.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for the first 5 to 15 minutes to pass and for the candle/wick to bounce off the 13 EMA support
variants.target_note: exit into the quick upward move / nearby resistance
variants.transcript_quote: time your entries once you have allowed the first 5 to 15 minutes to pass ... look at this indicator the 13 EMA in this example on the 5 minute chart

variants.variant_label: bounce off support after price forms/retests the level
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter when price comes back down and bounces again off the same support level
variants.target_note: take the quick move up and exit
variants.transcript_quote: it came back down again boom same level you enter here and then boom you got this move

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: use the 200 EMA as deeper support once the 13 EMA loses support status
variants.target_note: ride the move to resistance and exit
variants.transcript_quote: you want to understand is you get in and out ... this one off a deeper support sitting at the 200 EMA once the 13 EMA gave up its support status

strategies.name: ema_support_breakdown_short
strategies.entry_summary: When price loses the support level, especially after breaking below the 200 EMA support, enter in the direction of the breakdown for the larger scalp move. The transcript frames this as the move you really want to catch after support fails.
strategies.exit_summary: Exit into the continuation leg after the breakdown move has extended; the speaker points to the move down as the place to get out, again stressing a quick in-and-out scalp.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter once the stock loses the 200 EMA support / support level breaks
variants.target_note: cover into the big down move after the break
variants.transcript_quote: once we lost the support of the 200 look at this move boom boom boom you want to exit right there

variants.variant_label: lost 13 EMA support then continuation lower
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: after the 13 EMA no longer holds as support, use the failed support as the trigger for the short scalp
variants.target_note: take profit on the ensuing decline
variants.transcript_quote: once the 13 EMA gave up its support status
